thread:
Maria P: Quick heads-up — CloudNova reported a regression in their marketplace sandbox after switching to CUDA 12.3 + NVIDIA driver 535.8.8. Their perf telemetry shows a 25% tail latency increase on A100s. Can partners-team own the coordination?
Tom H: Yikes. Do we have repro logs from their sandbox?
Maria P: They attached a small repro and traces. Key symptom: sudden jump in matmul kernel time at ~200 tokens. Sending link: https://files.cloudnova/sbx/traces/176123
Sandeep R: I pulled the trace. Looks like a kernel fallback path that activates when workspace alloc crosses 3GB. Could be driver change in 535.x.
Jenna C: Is this affecting our hosted marketplace images or only their custom AMI?
Maria P: Only on their marketplace image so far. But they mirror our runtime base + some SI deps. We should assume potential impact to marketplace customers.
Tom H: Can we pin their marketplace offering to the previous driver (535.8.7) while we triage? What's the command for a quick pin?
Alex K: Use our control tool: `redwoodctl marketplace pin-driver --partner cloudnova --driver "nvidia:535.8.7" --until 2026-03-30`
Maria P: @deploy-bot can you run a dry-check for compatibility before we pin?
deploy-bot: dry-check started for cloudnova image id cnv-20260318-01. Logs: https://deploy-logs/redwood/176123. Status: OK for pin, no ABI mismatches detected. :white_check_mark:
Sandeep R: I also ran a quick smoke on an A100 dev node with 535.8.7 vs 535.8.8. Repro script: 
```
python perf_smoke.py --model t5-large --seq 512 --batch 8 --driver 535.8.8
```
Results: 535.8.7 median 28ms, 535.8.8 median 35ms, tail worsened.
Jenna C: If pin is safe, we should do a brief comms plan with CloudNova: tell them we're pinning their marketplace image to 535.8.7 and working with driver vendor for root cause. Offer a canary to test 535.8.8 once there's a driver-side hotfix.
Tom H: Agreed. Maria, can you confirm the window and action?
Maria P: I'll request pin today and request a timeline from CloudNova for repro artifacts. Action items: 1) Pin marketplace image to 535.8.7 (temporary) 2) Share telemetry and trace with NVIDIA/ROCm partners 3) Validate canary once vendor provides patch 4) Update marketplace status page.
Alex K: I'll create the pin: `redwoodctl marketplace pin-driver --partner cloudnova --driver "nvidia:535.8.7" --reason "regression observed on 535.8.8" --expires 2026-03-30` and file a ticket #PN-4921.
deploy-bot: Pin operation queued (op id 842019). Expected rollout: 15m.
Sandeep R: Also adding a short test harness to our nightly canary that runs the repro at seq 512 and posts alerts if tail latency regresses >15%. I'll link PR shortly.
Jenna C: I'll draft a short comms blurb for CloudNova and marketplace customers, keep it technical but concise.
Tom H: One more ask — check ROCm side too in case partner has AMD variants. We should run symmetric checks.
Maria P: Good call. I'll ask CloudNova to confirm which images/instance types are impacted.
Alex K: Ticket PN-4921 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PN-4921 — includes repro, traces, and pin op id 842019.
Maria P: Thanks team. If anyone sees new telemetry post-pin, drop it here and we'll escalate to NVIDIA/ROCm partners. :thumbsup:
